svg.title: IT support technician — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as it support technician, wearing a collared shirt and a communications headset. Visible work cue: Open-ended maintenance wrench with a clearly separated jaw and long diagonal handle; the person also wears the shared support headset. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a communications headset.
